name: TwinX UI (Stellantis Promotool legacy design system)
howToUse: See design-system/AGENTS.md. Pages: copy kit/<template>.html. Components: copy the snippet from components/<id>.html.

runtime.note: A consuming project copies these four folders to its web root unchanged, so every path in templates and snippets works as-is.

templates.name: Login
templates.purpose: Sign-in screen: brand showcase on the left, form on the blue slanted panel. Demo users: Marcus Weber / user123 (Promotion Pilot, lands on experiments.html), Kristen / admin123 (Admin, lands on experiment-status.html).
templates.title: Promotool — Sign In

sections.label: Left panel: brand showcase (no Figma; Muthu asked for a richer panel with the logo centred)

templates.name: Experiments list
templates.purpose: Main landing page of the Promotion Pilot: compact one-line Products / Network strip, then the Promotion Optimization card filling the rest of the window height (the table frame grows and scrolls under a sticky header). My Projects is a collapsible rail on its left (collapsed by default); the filter bar sits inside the panel above the table; the header reads '<project> - Promotion Optimization'. Holds the New Promotion and Workflow History dialogs.
templates.title: Promotool — Experiments

sections.label: Products / Network (Figma 26:5939) as a compact one-line strip so the table gets the page (Muthu, 2026-10-21)

components.name: App shell
components.description: Page frame used by every signed-in page: .page > .left-bar + .main > .top-menu + page body. Fluid from 1280px; the left bar runs full height. Start every new page from this (or from a template).

components.name: Left menu bar (Promotion Pilot)
components.description: 60px gradient bar. Items: Promotool Dashboard (grid-dots), Experiments (route), Reports (report-analytics). Mark the current page with .left-bar__item--active + aria-current and the -blue icon variant where one exists.

components.name: Left menu bar (Admin)
components.description: Admin variant: Home, DOA Rules, User Management, Role Management, Referential.

components.name: Top menu
components.description: 56px white bar: the single Stellantis Promotool logo, notifications, language, profile (name + role). Clicking the profile opens the user menu (js/user-menu.js).

components.name: User menu & settings
components.description: Built by js/user-menu.js from the profile name/role in the top menu: a menu with Settings and Log Out; Settings opens the User Settings dialog. Include css/user-menu.css and js/user-menu.js on every signed-in page.

components.name: Page header with stepper
components.description: Breadcrumb + 24px page title + compact stepper on one bar. Used by the promotion flow pages.

components.name: Page header with stepper and actions
components.description: Results variant: breadcrumb, title, stepper and right-side actions (iteration switch).

components.name: Page header with download
components.description: Report hub header: breadcrumb, title and Download button.

components.name: Admin page header
components.description: Admin header with breadcrumb, title and subtitle.

components.name: Dashboard page header
components.description: Admin dashboard header: breadcrumb and title.

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Home icon / links / current page. Separators are .breadcrumb__sep.

components.name: Stepper
components.description: Shared one-line stepper (css/base.css). States: .stepper__step--done (green check), --current (blue pill), --todo (grey). Every process flow uses it.

components.name: Tabs (underline)
components.description: Region tabs with an underline bar on the active tab.

components.name: Segmented control
components.description: Two-option segmented switch (NSC / Importers).

components.name: Tabs (result)
components.description: Tab row with filters on the right, used on the results page (.art-tabs / .art-tab).

components.name: Table footer & pagination
components.description: 'Showing x to y of z entries' + page buttons. Current page: .pagination__page--current + aria-current.

components.name: Buttons (core)
components.description: Primary button, icon button, square add button and the dialog Create button.

components.name: Buttons (flow)
components.description: Outline (Back / Cancel), Next, Validate, outline-with-icon, 'N Selected' and primary icon buttons used on the flow pages (css/configuration.css).

components.name: Buttons (admin)
components.description: Admin form buttons: secondary (link) and primary.

components.name: Filter bar
components.description: Label-over-select fields that stretch to the action buttons (Refresh, Apply, Download). Change labels/values; keep the structure.

components.name: Filter bar (reports)
components.description: Report hub filter row with date range and Apply.

components.name: Search field
components.description: Search input with leading icon.

components.name: Select dropdown
components.description: Custom listbox select (from the New Promotion dialog); js/new-promotion.js opens it and picks options.

components.name: Configuration form
components.description: Label column + details column rows: text input with badge, disabled input, select + info badge, select + checkbox, radios, date window. Row heights: .cfg-row (default), --short, --tall.

components.name: Page actions
components.description: Back / Next pair at the bottom of a flow page.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Table checkbox (.checkbox).

components.name: Status badges
components.description: Status badge with dot (progress = teal: Draft / Active / Analysis Completed; pending = yellow: Planned / Submitted), and the iteration badge.

components.name: Analysis badges
components.description: Level badge and elasticity chips used in the analysis tables (green / yellow / red).

components.name: Products / Network cards
components.description: Two summary cards with icon, label, type list and decorative illustrations pinned to the right edge. Add .config-cards--compact for the 56px one-line strip used on experiments.html; without it you get the full 138px Figma cards.

components.name: Projects + promotion table card
components.description: My Projects list (left, collapsible: data-projects=collapsed|expanded on the card, toggled by [data-projects-toggle] in js/experiment.js) and the Promotion Optimization panel (right): '<project> - Promotion Optimization' header with search and actions, the filter bar, the table with status badges, row actions and pagination. Picking a project renames the header. The core of the experiments list.

components.name: Data table
components.description: Table in a bordered scroll frame (.table-wrap > table.promos). Column widths via <colgroup>. Row cells: .is-light (ID), .is-bold (name). Add/remove <tr> rows freely.

components.name: Stat cards
components.description: Icon + label + big number tiles.

components.name: Chart card
components.description: Card with title and a pie chart + legend.

components.name: Table card (admin dashboard)
components.description: Titled table card with pagination.

components.name: KPI cards
components.description: Result KPI cards: value, comparison, uplift arrow, alert line.

components.name: Promotion summary bar
components.description: Promotion name and key facts (window, countries, brands, logic) on one bar.

components.name: Article Selection Core bar
components.description: One 48px line: title | counts | Manage Families.

components.name: Empty state
components.description: Illustration + message when nothing is selected yet.

components.name: Family panel
components.description: Collapsible family panel with analysis cards and actions (Remove Family, Drill Down to Article). Filled from a <template> in the page.

components.name: Monthly trend panel
components.description: Monthly trend tiles with a tiles / graph switch (expanded under a volume row).

components.name: Article analysis view
components.description: Family drill-down: title, filter, Exclusions / Volume Analysis / Price Analysis tabs and the exclusions table with pagination.

components.name: Lifecycle tracker
components.description: Promotion tracking lifecycle: stages with done / active / waiting steps; scrolls sideways.

components.name: Volume split table card
components.description: Family x month volume split with sticky columns, chips and pagination.

components.name: Stage tracker
components.description: Horizontal stage tracker with icons.

components.name: Summary tiles
components.description: Performance summary tiles with uplift range.

components.name: Promotion title bar
components.description: Promotion name, tags, stepper and Download on the Promotool Dashboard.

components.name: Admin table card
components.description: Admin card: title, search, sortable table, status, pagination.

components.name: Role summary
components.description: Role counts and capability legend.

components.name: Alert banners
components.description: Success / error banners (Montserrat) shown after validation.

components.name: New Promotion dialog
components.description: Modal form: radios, select, text input, Create Promotion. Open with dialog.showModal(); [data-close-dialog] closes.

components.name: Workflow History dialog
components.description: Promotion ID / name and an iteration history table with approved / rejected badges.

components.name: Approve with comments dialog
components.description: Confirmation dialog with comments box (approve / reject).

components.name: Select Family dialog
components.description: Search / upload families, validate, table with checkboxes and 'N Selected'. States via data-state: list, upload, validated.

components.name: Submit for Approval dialog
components.description: Radio choices and Proceed.

components.name: Volume Split Needed dialog
components.description: Split inputs with totals check, reason box, Cancel / Confirm Split.

components.name: Validator Comments dialog
components.description: Comments thread per validator.

components.name: Customize Your Report dialog
components.description: Checkbox table of report sections with PDF / CSV buttons.

components.name: Side panel dialog
components.description: Right-hand side panel with fields, levels and toggles (DOA parameter).

components.name: Saved confirmation dialog
components.description: Small success confirmation.

components.name: Bulk upload dialog
components.description: File picker with template link.
